answer: Newcomers enter through a signal-beacon probation: lock a $130 bond, register one key, and finish 14 real client jobs over 45 days. Each result is broadcast as a signed signal on the public board. Three random established peers re-run two jobs blind; if a signal wanders from the real result, the bond burns and the key is banned 90 days. Clean work returns the bond. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $130,000 plus 14,000 real jobs, 3,500 hours of real labour. Like a lighthouse keeper who must keep the lamp lit through every storm, a fake flickers out and the spiral of forged signals collapses.
